WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category AS cat_was,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, p.category, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category AS cat_asis, n.cat_was,
       SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id = 900 THEN n.net_sales END) AS web_part,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines, MIN(d.calendar_date) AS dmin, MAX(d.calendar_date) AS dmax
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
  AND (cp.category IN ('Garden','Electrical') OR n.cat_was IN ('Garden','Electrical'))
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 1, 2, 3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine_total
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(r.net_sales) AS rpt_total, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=999 THEN r.net_sales END) AS rpt_999
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1
),
dups AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines,
           COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dup_receipt_lines
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2024/25')
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.fiscal_year, m.mine_total, c.rpt_total, c.rpt_999, du.lines, du.distinct_lines, du.dup_receipt_lines
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year) JOIN dups du USING (fiscal_year)

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.sku, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_year AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 8
      AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2024/25')
      AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.category,
       ty.fiscal_year,
       8 AS fiscal_period,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales,
       ly.fiscal_year AS comparison_fiscal_year,
       ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS comparison_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM by_year ty
JOIN by_year ly ON ly.category = ty.category AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY ty.category
